people.name: Abinadab
people.line: Kept the ark of God in his house

people.name: Ahio
people.line: Son of Abinadab, accompanied the ark from Kiriath-jearim

people.name: Uzzah
people.line: Died while moving the ark; place named after him

translations.web: They set God’s ark on a new cart, and brought it out of Abinadab’s house that was on the hill; and Uzzah and Ahio, the sons of Abinadab, drove the new cart.
translations.bsb: They set the ark of God on a new cart and brought it from the house of Abinadab, which was on the hill. Uzzah and Ahio, the sons of Abinadab, were guiding the new cart,
translations.kjv: And they set the ark of God upon a new cart, and brought it out of the house of Abinadab that was in Gibeah: and Uzzah and Ahio, the sons of Abinadab, drave the new cart.
translations.asv: And they set the ark of God upon a new cart, and brought it out of the house of Abinadab that was in the hill: and Uzzah and Ahio, the sons of Abinadab, drove the new cart.
